resources.string: Paste a link or search YouTube
When a video link is shared
Paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook… or type words to search YouTube.\n\nTip: in any app tap Share → VidSaver.
Search for a song or artist.\nResults download as MP3 by default.
No videos yet.\nDownloaded videos appear here.
No music yet.\nDownload a song as MP3 and it appears here.
No files yet.\nPDFs, APKs, ZIPs and other files appear here.

1. Copy or share a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X or any website → Share → VidSaver.

2. Or paste a link in the Download tab and tap Go.

3. Or type words (e.g. a song name) to search YouTube, then tap MP4 or MP3.

4. YouTube and More open sites inside VidSaver: open a video and tap the orange Download button.

5. Finished downloads are in the Play tab and in your phone's Download/VidSaver folder.

Please download only content you own or have permission to download.
